verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents issuing virtual cards in one click, each with a limit sized to its purpose. It also documents creating purpose-specific cards (travel, software, ads) and assigning them to team members. Its API supports issuing, topping up and adjusting the ceiling and controls of virtual cards (VCN). However, nothing documents issuing physical cards to team members: the evidence only shows listing, blocking and unblocking existing corporate cards, filtered by type and cardholder. Missing for 10: documented physical card issuance and per-card limits on physical cards, plus independent or hands-on confirmation of the 'in minutes' speed.
